connector.name: GuruPDF
connector.registryDescription: Convert, compress & merge PDFs and 100+ file formats from any AI agent. By GuruPDF.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package gurupdf-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the gurupdf account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: GURUPDF_API_KEY
env.description: Your GuruPDF API token (create one at https://gurupdf.com/profile)

env.name: GURUPDF_API_URL
env.description: API base URL; override only for self-hosting
